cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The table can float while we pack. That wet cup needs a mat. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Wait! You'll slide the cup across the polish. Get the stepladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb up. I've still got my muddy boots on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! Socks too if they're damp. We are not adding footprints to that water ring.
